messages.text: You working that late truck today?
Yes ma'am. I put the rice and okra containers in your freezer, top shelf.
I found them. Before you roll out, sit still a minute like I taught you.
Already did. Had your old alto part in my head while I packed my bag.
Morning baby. I saw the two bowls with green tape. Is one for today?
Yes ma'am. Green is Tuesday supper, blue is Wednesday lunch. I wrote the times on the lids.
You did too much again, but thank you. Call me after your run settles.
I will. Keep your phone by you and don't wait on me if you're ready to eat.
You still coming Saturday at 7, or did that last stair-chair call do you in?
Coming, just slower. I already did the band routine and put the ice pack behind my left leg.
Good. Bring the sleeve if we walk past the pier. No proving anything on soft sand.
Packed it. And I said no to the extra 12 tonight, so I can actually move by morning.
You make it home after that late run?
Just walked in. Going to rinse off and sit still with the blue notebook before I talk much.
Call me after if you want. I can do ten.
Maybe after I put Kind of Blue on low.
I moved the blue chair back by the TV. Tipoff is 7:30 if you get clear in time.
Good. I put the Broward tickets on the fridge too so I don't forget them after shift.
I'll warm the rice and keep the remote on the right channel. We can check seats for that Saturday show after halftime.
Andre said he can come by after he leaves Miramar, but I told him don't climb on that wobbly stool.
Good. I left the new hallway bulb and the little screwdriver set on the kitchen counter.
He also asked if I still had my old white shoes from the floor days. I told him they are in the closet with your daddy's route clipboard.
Leave that box alone until I get there. Last thing we need is you pulling down heavy stuff.
Is Marcus coming down this month or just calling Sunday?
Calling this Sunday. He said the drive from Orlando may wait until April.
Tell Tasha I still have the flyer from her youth night on my fridge.
I will. She is coming from Miami Gardens after her evening class if traffic behaves.
Ma, are my old computer boxes still in that back room closet?
They are, but I need that corner cleared before Saturday. The easel, tripod, and frame stack are all fighting for space.
I can come down later this month and take the tower box. Don't toss the cables yet.
I will keep the cables. I just need floor room for the large canvas and the six sunrise prints from A1A.
You still meeting me Saturday at 6:40 by the north lot? Tide should be low.
Yes. I want those pink clouds over the water before the walkers crowd the pier.
Bring the small camera this time. Your phone keeps washing out the sky.
Small camera, old glass for now. The other one can sit in the cart until the car work is paid.
You off the floor after report? I typed three lines and erased them. Better if I just ring you.
Give me 15. Finishing charting and one family update.
Okay. Marsha texted a thumbs-up too, said she remembers those tones too well.
Call me first, then her if you still need to empty your head. Keep names out of it.
They picked Wynwood for Friday. Rooftop, loud music, probably bottle service.
I can come by after shift, but I'm ordering one glass with food and switching to lime soda.
Fair. I will ask for a table away from that corner patio so you don't come home smelling like everybody else's bad decisions.
Thank you. And tell Maya I am passing on anything homemade from her purse again.
Ma, Dad said you barely slept and then got sharp with him about the grocery bags. You good?
Ma, that bakery mural you saved is the same place hosting the youth table Saturday. Can you put my flyer on your page?
I apologized. Last night kept replaying when I laid down, and I skipped my walk this morning.
I can share it after I crop the pastelito photo. Comments off if people start acting wild.
Go sit with your paints for ten minutes, even if you just rinse brushes. And eat something.
Please leave the address showing. And send me the handle for that drummer you tagged yesterday.
I can do that. I am not falling apart, just need to stop pretending a double shift did not land hard.
Got you. I followed him from the Little Haiti gallery clip, so I have to find it again.
Andre called last night asking what year we left Savannah. He always forgets.
Baby I was up early thinking on your daddy. Ten years this summer.
Tell him I was about 12. He was barely walking around then. He should remember the Lauderdale house better since that's where we were when I turned 16.
He remembers the back porch and your father grilling. Said he wants to drive down for my birthday.
I know mama. Hard to believe it's been since 2016. I'll bring the white roses when I come Sunday.
Good. Tell him to come the weekend before so it's not crowded with church folks.
He'd be proud you stuck with the truck after all this time.
Almost thirty years on a rig. He used to say the flash cards on the kitchen table were going to change my whole life. He wasn't wrong.
Heard the call on Sunrise tonight got cleared by a different unit. You okay?

Yeah. Guy was off his meds, sitting on the curb talking to nobody. Patrol pulled up with three cars and lights. We finally got them to back the cars off and I sat with him about twenty minutes till he came down.
Twenty minutes versus a takedown. That's the whole argument right there.
If a co-response unit had rolled instead of three cruisers it would have ended faster and quieter. Same outcome, less trauma. We keep saying it.
You still trying for 6:50 by the Las Olas bathrooms tomorrow? Tide should be low.
If dispatch lets me out on time, yes. Shoes are already by the door.
Good. If you get stuck and it is still dark, wait at the coffee stand until we come around.
That is my plan. I am not doing the quiet blocks alone after a long shift.
You still doing the Carter Park table in the morning?
Yes. I wiped down both cuffs and printed the one-page handout with the big font.
Good. Folks listen better when it is not all medical words.
Exactly. I am putting Pastor Lee first on the mic before I start numbers.
Ma you riding with me tomorrow or meeting me on Sistrunk? I can swing through 17th and grab you after work
Meet me there. I want to come straight from the bay so I can change out of the uniform first.
okay. and the forum at Broward Health on the 21st — I put your name on the RSVP, the one about pressure and sugar in our neighborhoods. that's the only other one this month, promise
That's enough for me Tasha. Two is what I can give this month. I'll be at Sistrunk by 6, don't text me to do five more.
You up baby? Heard the rain start.
Up since five. Boots are by the door, shirt pressed last night. Drive safe yourself today.
Mrs. Ortiz from downstairs been asking if you can come by sometime, says her son don't speak good English and she tries to translate for the doctors.
Tell her I only know what we use on the truck, presión, dolor de pecho, the simple stuff. But I'll sit with her after my Saturday shift and we can call the office together.
Baby did that money come in yesterday? I don't want you using the card for my pharmacy if it is tight.
It came in before I left. I put your CVS and labs on mine and moved the rest where it belongs.
Good. And ask the work people why that little Local 140 line keeps showing.
I will. Renee said the rep is at the station Tuesday, so I'll bring the paper then.
Baby did you put anything in my Publix card? I can wait if not.
I added 90 this morning and left the pharmacy receipt in your drawer. Daryl and I are keeping March closer to the normal 6400 side after February got high.
Baby don't spend your bill money on my pharmacy things. I can wait till Tuesday.
Thank you. Don't stretch yourself for me.
You're fine, Ma. I already moved my Friday amount before the light bill hit.
You're fine. I just have to watch the house pull on the 12th and the car one after that.
You always did better when you put it away before you looked at it.
Exactly. I left the house card alone and used the little side bucket for your $46 copay.
You coming by after work or are you too tired?
Coming by. We had a late transport and I still had to finish the patient care report, but I am off now.
Don't rush. Bring those papers I asked about if they are in your bag.
I have them. I did my four days already this week, so tomorrow I can sit with you after church.
Still meeting at the beach at 7? I am bringing coffee after, but you better bring that blue mat.
I am coming. Packed the mat, water, and my little pill case before I left the house.
Good. We can keep the pace easy and do the hip stretches by the lifeguard stand.
Easy pace sounds right. I prepped bowls last night too, so I am not grabbing salty takeout after shift.
did you finish the Sentinel piece on Patel? feels like she's the only one actually sitting through the budget meetings
read it last night. waiting to see what the nurses association sends before I make up my mind, they had someone at the Q&A taking notes
smart. the FOP forum was a Tuesday I think, somebody posted the whole video on the Lauderhill community page if you want it
oh good I'll pull it up after shift. you usually have these people figured out two weeks before I do lol
Costco was packed. Got the D cells and two cases of water. They were out of the big AAs.
Good. Did they have the 5 gallon cans? I think we're one short in the garage.
Only quart sizes left. I'll swing by Home Depot Saturday and grab one. Pricey but I'd rather have it sitting now.
Add it to the list on the fridge. I'll cross off batteries when you get home.
You still coming before my lab on Wednesday?
Yes ma'am. I put your ride at 9:20. I'm using today to finish those airway pages and the new-hire worksheet before dinner.
Don't sit there all day. Your back talks louder than you do.
I know. That's why I'm looking hard at work where I can use my head more and not climb stairs with bags forever.
Baby did you make those greens today or are you resting?
They are on low now. I used the smoked turkey and that little red pepper from the Broward market, so I will label yours mild.
Good. Put me two small bowls aside and don't forget your water for morning.
Already filled both bottles. I am taking a bowl with fruit and nuts so I won't chase vending food.
Auntie sent Grandma another short clip. Want me to drop it in the family chat?
Ma, are my old boxes still in that hall closet or did Dad move them for the filter job?
No, send her Dr. Nguyen's portal note and the state health page instead. I'll read both after shift.
Still there. He pulled the ladder out but left your boxes alone.
Cool. Also your Excel file was still opening slow Sunday. Want me to clean up the extra tabs when I come down?
Got it. You still doing the Walgreens stop before Sunday call?
Yes, quick card update. Then I'll call your grandma so she hears it plain.
Yes please. I already copied the water, light, and card totals into the blue book so nothing gets lost.
Beach walk was good. Did you ever upload that pharmacy receipt before it disappeared in your purse?
Did it while the coffee brewed. Same folder as the lab slip from February.
Good. And please tell me you didn't leave that rescue supply bill sitting until the last day again.
Nope. Sent the whole card balance this morning and moved the $40 copay money back where it belongs.
I checked the tires before I left. Oil change place opens at 7:30 if you still want it done before the I-95 run.
Yes. I put in for that whole week, so I don't want the car acting up once we get past Jacksonville.
Good. Text Cheryl today about which porch we're meeting on. Your mama said the house with the blue steps, but that could be three houses.
I'll ask. I also want one morning clear for the squares before everybody starts cooking.
You made it home from that late call?
Home. Daryl saw my face and didn't start asking. Just pointed me to the shower.
Good. Let the house stay quiet tonight.
It will. He put tea on the nightstand and took his game to the den.
Ma, my coworker said Kingston has a whole weekend of drums and street food in July. I sent you the flyer.
I saw it. That one caught my eye more than a plain beach package.
Take Dad too. He can act quiet all he wants but he needs a real break.
That part. I just want the numbers to stop making every idea feel like a math test.
Mike from 14 called the house phone. Said they're short tomorrow night. Asked if you'd pick up the back half of the shift.
Tell him no. I already pulled Saturday and Monday. Three in a week is how I tore the knee up in October.
Want me to call back or just text him.
Text. Short. Don't apologize for me. Saturday is Renee's walk and I'm not giving that up too.
Mom one of the youth tonight asked how I knew CPR. I told her grandpa would've gotten a kick out of you teaching me on the carpet when I was 9.
Ha. That was right after I came up on that crash on US-1 in my twenties. I came home shaking and signed up that next Monday. Couldn't ever unsee it.
Wish grandpa got to see how long you stuck with it. He'd be 80 next year right?
He would. Almost a decade gone now. Bring the kiddo by Sunday, mama's cooking.
House draft cleared. Escrow part looked same as last time.
Good. I paid FPL and water before shift, then I'll do car insurance Friday and gas card after payday.
Keep groceries light this weekend?
Yes. If we stay around 6700 this one won't look like February.
I put the no-salt seasoning up front and left your refill bag by the keys.
Thank you. I already filled the Sunday boxes and packed two lunches for tomorrow.
Good. Heat tipoff is 8, so we can eat first if you still want to do your floor stretches.
Let me do 15 minutes first. My back and shoulders were tight after the stair chair call.
Ma, you want me to order that longer grabber thing for the pantry? I found one with a magnetic tip.
Send the link. After yesterday's bari bag and the low cabinet at your grandma's, I'm not bending for soup cans.
Ordered. Also please don't take two of those orange bottle tablets close together like last time.
I won't. One with food only if the ice doesn't settle it.
Did Grandma get the soup I left in your freezer or should I bring something down Sunday?
I took hers over yesterday. Yours is still here. If you come, bring yourself and drive in daylight.
Daylight, yes ma'am. She answer you today?
Talked at lunch. She fussed about me putting dates on everything, so she's fine enough to fuss.
You still walking Saturday or did they put you back on the board?
I kept Saturday open. They asked me to cover an extra 8 on Sunday, but I said no unless the bills get ugly.
Good. Your knee needs one morning that isn't a stretcher and stairs.
Exactly. My check comes from the truck already; I am not adding another place on top of that.
My youth group wants something for Saturday. One kid's auntie keeps sending that garlic-water thing for chest pain.
Send me the flyer draft before you post it. No scare words, just what to watch for and who to call.
Can you do the little cuff demo after lunch too?
I can bring the wrist one. Have Ms. Janice introduce it first so they do not tune me out.
ma did you catch the forum tonight?? D4 thing, Antoine's mom shared it in the group earlier
saw her post this morning. I'm finishing a 24, I'll watch the recording tomorrow. you streaming live?
yes!!! also Broward teachers just dropped their forum notes, sending. you always make me check four things before voting lol
good. I want to read what they wrote about the parks bond before I say a word to your dad about it
Mom did you see the school board candidate forum recap? Three of them just kept saying "protect our kids" with zero plan for the nurse shortage or the bus routes.
Saw it. Slogans don't staff a clinic or run a bus. I'll vote for whoever shows up Tuesday with a number next to their promise.
lol same. The one who actually had numbers on Title I funding is who I'm pushing. Want me to forward you her two-pager?
Yes send it. And the sample ballot pdf if the county put it up yet.
You sounded tight on the phone. Want me to come by after class?
No baby, stay put. I wrote a page, and Daryl put the kettle on.
Okay. At least put something on that lets you feel it and then sleep.
Etta is already doing that.
Panel guy called. I can meet him at 2 if you leave the folder by the door.
Folder is on the chair with the 2008 papers and the March statement.
Got it. I’ll handle the breaker and haul the old shelf out after.
Thanks. I’ll update the grocery list and enter the payment line tonight.
Tire shop called. Nail is too close to the wall. They said $397 out the door.
I left the insurance envelope by the coffee maker. Need your March paper for the budget?
Use the credit union bucket, not the card. I'll replace it in two payrolls.
Yes. The month is showing 4,902 before taxes and all those lines. After everything it is closer to 3,498.
Then we can cover FPL and still keep Gloria's grocery money aside.
Main account still has groceries and insurance coming.
That's why I keep that Friday pull separate. Main money gets spoken for too fast.
Let me ask the station rep about that Local 140 piece before I file it.
Baby, church fish fry is Saturday. Sister Jean said she saved you a seat near the door.
Near the side door is fine if the breeze is clean. Last year that back bench had my uniform smelling wrong.
I will tell them. You want tea with lemon like usual?
Yes ma'am. Tea is enough for me, and no samples from folks' little jars.
Sister Mae sent me a Facebook thing saying I can skip the next arm thing.
Hold that until Dr. Nguyen sees your labs. I can call the county line too if the dates don't match.
You keep your own paper straight?
Yes ma'am. My CVS receipt is clipped behind the January card copy.
You still walking tomorrow at 7? The sky should be clear by the pier.
Yes. I am bringing the small camera before we start. Need one more orange-horizon shot to match the downtown night ones.
I'll wait by the showers. Don't make your knee mad climbing rocks for the perfect angle.
No rocks. Just the tripod, then home to the back room before the gesso dries.
Mama how was the meeting last night?? Did Captain Reyes actually show up or send the deputy again
Reyes sent the deputy. Same as January. They want the footage window pushed to 60 days now. Half the board sat there nodding.
60?? That's how things get buried. Whole point is we see it before the story sets
I said as much in the comment slot. Cameras don't do anything if the supervisor decides what gets out and when. Also flagged the two-step approval chain. We'll see if it makes the minutes.
Can we do Sunday a little later? I promised the center I'd help clean up after the teen mural thing.
The teens are setting up their wall pieces for Friday. You coming after work?
Later is fine. Marcus said he can call after his support queue slows down.
I can come for an hour. I still want to see the colors they picked, and maybe grab plantains nearby.
Good. Tell him I still need help getting that old laptop to stop freezing before class Monday.
Bring that water shot you showed me. The orange one.
He will fuss, then fix it. Same as when you two were younger.
I will print the phone version. The sharper glass waits; the house and Mom's pharmacy run took priority.
You made it off on time?
Yes. Changing now, then meeting Renee near Las Olas before 7.
Take the bright jacket. Call me if nobody is there yet.
I will wait by the open coffee place until I see them.
Patch on your left sleeve coming loose again. Saw it when you hung it up.
Ugh I felt it pulling at the call on Sunrise. Family only spoke Spanish, I was leaning over the dad doing chest compressions and could feel it lift.
I'll iron the new one on tomorrow before you head out. You got 6 a.m.?
6:30 in. I'll lay it all out tonight so I can grab and go. Thanks babe. The mom kept saying respira papi respira, I'm still hearing it.
Did you say you were bringing me batteries today?
Yes ma'am. Picked up a pack of AAs and a small lantern for the hallway. Need anything from Publix while I'm out?
See if my radio still works. And maybe one more flashlight for the bedroom. The one on my nightstand is yellowed up.
Will do. I'll write radio batteries on the list at your place too so we don't forget next trip.
Baby did you get the strips from Publix or should I wait until Monday?
Got them. Used the work benefits card first, then paid the rest from the little copay stash.
Thank you. Don't put my things on that house card if it squeezes you.
It's fine. I already cleared what was on it after payday, so groceries and your strips are covered.
When you go through my cedar chest, don't throw away that little hospital bracelet. It is wrapped in the pink blanket.
I saw it. The envelope has the Georgia address written in your handwriting.
Keep it with the photos from West 41st. Cheryl may want copies when you are up there.
I'll scan them before we leave. I can bring the originals back after the week.
Ma, what do you put in the pot after you wash the greens? Mine came out flat.
Start with onion, garlic, a little vinegar near the end, and don't dump all the pepper in at once.
Is that the pepper from that place by Sunrise or regular grocery?
For that pot, the small place. Publix is fine for the bunches and turkey.
Dad said y'all are doing couch dinner before the night game. You want me to text the streaming login?
Yes please. He already pulled out the old aqua towel like that helps the defense.
Also, that drummer you liked is listed at Broward on the 21st. Balcony still has pairs.
Send the link. If the total isn't crazy, I'll ask your dad before the second half starts.
Ma, for the peas do I use smoked turkey first or just throw it all in?
Turkey first with onion. Low and slow. That's how your grandma did it before everybody crowded her kitchen.
Got it. Also what was that song you and grandma kept humming last Sunday?
I'll voice-note it after I lay my uniform out. Same tune my mama used to hum over the stove.
Beach walk or did the binder win again?
Binder after breakfast. I marked the 12-lead section last night and still need the drug math sheet.
Bring the knee brace if you walk. And let the younger crews do the hero lifting.
That's the plan. I can still be useful showing folks how to think through a scene without proving anything with my joints.
You okay? You went quiet after that shift post you almost made.
I took it down before anybody saw much. Renee let me talk while she folded scrubs.
Good. Did you call Marsha too?
Later. She can hear one line and know which kind of night it was.
I can stop by Grandma's after class, but I can't fix that sink thing. Did Andre answer?
He did. He's picking up the part near Miramar first, then heading to Lauderhill.
Okay. I found that photo of Grandma in those white lace-up shoes by the bed cart. She looked tired but sharp.
She stayed sharp. Your granddad had the same look in every picture with that hand truck and stack of invoices.
I-95 got stopped near Sunrise tonight. Two cruisers. I sat there for a minute before I figured out it wasn't me.
Marcus. Hands where they could see, registration on the dash like we said?
Yeah. I'm fine ma. Just wanted to tell you before grandma calls tomorrow and you hear it from her instead.

Talked to your dad and to Renee about it. Brought it up at coffee with Pastor Joan and the deacons last Sunday too, after a different stop in Lauderhill. This isn't going away in our zip codes baby. Call me when you pull in.
Beach walk at 7 still happening, or are you coming straight home?
Going home. I stared at the canvas last night and could not pick up the brush.
Was it the pediatric call?
Yes. I handled the rig and paperwork fine, but my body stayed on duty after I clocked out.
You skipped the walk. Knee or overtime?
Overtime. I was looking at Nassau prices before bed and then picked up the extra shift.
Your sunrise shot from the walk made me want coffee. Was that the cafe with the blue tile?
Don't let one fare chart run your whole body down.
Same one. I saved their guava plate too, then dropped the church gym flyer on my other page.
Smart. Do not spend your Sunday answering every random cousin-of-a-cousin.
I know. Daryl said the same thing, then opened the Savannah hotel tabs like he was helping.
Already muted it. Going back to that sax player clip Tasha sent.
Are y'all cooking big today or should I bring food from Miami Gardens?
Bring yourself. I only bought salmon for me and your dad, then remembered you said you might come.
Lol okay. Also I found that photo of you two in the old kitchen with the flash cards.
Keep that one. He still teases me about those stacks after all these years.
Mama three things this week!! Tuesday voter reg at the North Lauderdale library, Thursday school board, Saturday community forum on the Hayes case at New Mt Olive. Tell me you're in for all three
One.
MOM

One, baby. I'll show up real for one. Pick which one needs my body in the room and I'm there. The other two send me the recap and I'll put money in instead. That's how I keep doing this for years, not weeks.
You watch the County Commission feed last night? The budget rep tried to pretend the ambulance response numbers in the north end were fine.
Watched the whole thing. Fine for who. We ran two arrests in that zone last month waiting on the second unit.
Exactly. And then they spent 40 min on the parks naming committee.
Pre-filled my ballot already for the two seats that actually voted to hold the EMS line. The amendment on the hospital district I'm still reading.
Mom the youth board is doing a panel on Black women in emergency services. They want a 50+ voice. You in?
Lol I'm 54, barely qualify. When?
September. You'll be 55 by then anyway, stop fronting.
Watch it. Send me the date and I'll see if it falls near my birthday weekend, I already promised your grandma dinner that Saturday.
Saw that clip going around about the guy in Sunrise. People in the comments are wild. One side says he was a threat, other side says cops made it worse
Don't trust the comments. Don't trust the headline either. Wait for the footage and read it yourself if they release it. Both campaigns are using that clip for something.
Yeah I figured. Was the unit on scene a co-response one or regular patrol?
Regular patrol. That's part of why it went the way it did. The co-response van was tied up across the county. Three counties south Broward has one van for nights. One.
You got held over?
Yes. I am taking the long way by the Intracoastal before I come in.
I will keep dinner warm. Ten or twenty?
Twenty. Then shower, quiet kitchen, Miles low.
Ma, did you eat too or just pack everybody else's little boxes?
I ate. Glo has two chicken plates, one greens cup, and the peach cup with no syrup. All marked.
Good. Please don't run yourself into the ground before your shift.
I hear you. I'm calling her at 4, then checking on the new girl from B-shift about her ride home.
The youth center lobby has that empty wall in April. Ms. Nia said small framed local work is okay if you bring hooks.
That might be the right size. I only have the Fort Lauderdale morning set and a few downtown streets ready.
Bring the canvas with the blue windows too. The teens liked that one when I showed them.
I will line everything up in the back room Sunday and see what fits in the car.
You left the blue bag by the door. Want me to put it in the car?
Please. It has the wrap, grapes, nuts, and yesterday's rice bowl.
I see the two waters too. Drive careful.
Thank you. When I get back I'll put the greens on before the game.
You already out by the water?
Parked. Got the thermos and the little camera. Sky is just starting to turn.
Okay. Be careful on the rocks. I moved that lens email to your folder, didn't delete it.
Thanks. Leave it there for April. This morning is enough with the old setup and the choir playlist.
Coffee's set. I put your knee sleeve by the keys.
Thank you. Washer done?
Yep. Only our uniforms and towels this load. I'll fold when I get back from the hospital shop.
Leave the porch light on if I'm late again.
Marcus asked if those boxes can stay in the hall closet until his next Orlando run.
They can stay. Tasha's canvases are still in there too, so it is already crowded.
When both are here, remind them to sort it before dinner.
I will. Marcus can lift the heavy stuff and Tasha can stop pretending school papers are storage.
Mom, that photo dump you sent had the best food truck angle. What lens filter is that?
Just the warm one. I was really trying to catch the wall art behind the line.
Also saw your county deadline share. Lock the replies if it turns into nonsense.
I did after two comments. I would rather follow that jazz trio's page than babysit grown folks.
Beach walk still on? I packed coffee and those ginger chews.
I'm here. Coffee yes, ginger chews no unless the wrapper is sealed and boring.
Sealed from Publix, nurse's honor. Brunch after?
Brunch is good. If they do mimosas I'll do one small one, then water. Early shift tomorrow.
You got called in?
Yes. Long one. I left the covered pan on warm for after Mama's appointment.
I heard you in the room before you came out. Take your time getting there.
Needed that minute. Put Grandma's track on low while I tied my boots.
Mail had two of those mailers again. Sheriff race and the judge one.
Keep em on the counter, I want to cross-check what the union endorsed vs what the civil rights coalition put out before I fill the ballot.
Ok. Coffee's on. You voting on lunch or after shift?
Lunch. Early site at the library so I can drop it off before pickup gets crazy.
Andre texted me. He wants to know if Mama's side gate still sticks before he drives over.
Yes, and ask him to look at the loose shelf over the laundry too.
I'll leave the drill bits out. I moved that old metal lunch pail and your dad's dock jacket off the shelf.
Thanks. Put Mama's pin box in the bedroom drawer so it doesn't get mixed with the tools.
Tea is on the counter. I left the kitchen quiet.
Thank you. I heard my tone earlier and did not like it. You did not deserve that.
I know. Tomorrow morning, short walk before Gloria's pharmacy run?
Yes. If I miss that and the brushes again, I will use Alvarez's number instead of waiting.
Sister Mae said you talked slow enough yesterday and did not make her feel foolish.
That matters. She came in worried because her neighbor told her not to call anybody unless she passed out.
I am glad you showed them the numbers on that little machine.
I just want them leaving with one clear next step, not ten confusing ones.
Beach walk still 7? I have to be in by 9:30.
Yes. Marsha said she may meet us by the pier if her knee behaves.
Bring the little notebook if you need to sort yesterday out before work.
I will. Better there with you two than leaving it sitting in a comment box.
Walking late, hip stiff. You at the pier?
Yeah. Andre's in town from Tampa, dragged him out here. He's complaining about the sand like he didn't grow up 10 minutes from this beach.
Ha. Tell little brother some of us still call this home turf.
He says he hasn't been on this stretch since the house on NW 19th. Twenty something years.
How'd you do on the MVA call today? I heard it came over the radio.
Rough one. Sedan vs. pickup on Federal. Took me right back to the one I rolled up on as a civilian before I ever picked up a stethoscope.

events.title: Lay out shirt + boots, badge, watch
events.notes: Shift starts 6:30 at Station 14. Mirror check, pockets, shears, pen. Run through frases otra vez: dolor, respira, dónde, embarazada, alergia.

events.title: Station 6 - Unit 12
events.notes: Check truck cabinet, radio battery, oxygen bottles, glucose kit, run tablet. Leon rides third seat for charting practice.

events.title: Beach loop, stretch, Walgreens
events.location: Fort Lauderdale Beach; Walgreens on Sunrise Blvd
events.notes: Pick up 90-day refill after walk. Bring water and do 10 minutes on the mat before leaving.

events.title: Payday sweep check
events.notes: $125 pull cleared to side acct; 403(b) line showing on stub; leave main acct alone until FPL posts.

events.title: Move money before 9th statement
events.notes: Check full balance on blue card; leave $85 untouched in clinic/lab envelope.

events.title: Garage check + run generator 20 min
events.notes: Rotate the two cases of water from last year. Top off fuel cans. Check D cells in the lantern. Cross off whatever's done on the fridge list.

events.title: Employee Health card check
events.notes: Bring badge and photo card. Compare last fall entry and January entry with portal list before signing station form.

events.title: Publix + Broward Blvd market before 12s
events.notes: Bananas, spring water, turkey slices, collards, thyme; check for Scotch bonnets if the small counter is open.

events.title: Meet the candidates — District 2
events.location: Lauderhill Central Park Library, community rm B
events.notes: Saw it on the Mt. Olive women's ministry page. Free, no RSVP. Bring a pen for the question card.

events.title: Kitchen table numbers w/ Daryl
events.notes: Close February column: 7,100. Check March auto-pulls for house note, escrow line, FPL, water, car note, cards, and Gloria envelope.

events.title: County updates + teaching packet
events.notes: Read new airway and cardiac pages. Add questions for ride-along check-off examples. Keep knees iced after.

events.title: Check Aruba Cafe reservation
events.notes: Ask for the small corner table. Card note: '1999 feels close when we get one quiet dinner.' Confirm no extra chairs.

events.title: March house numbers
events.notes: Update blue book, enter the March tab, check escrow notice and lawn supply receipt before Daryl starts the back fence repair list.

events.title: Compare MBJ / NAS / SAV fare holds
events.notes: Check Thursday returns, room blocks near the music weekend, and the bill sheet before anything gets held.

events.title: Call Aunt Cheryl re: March drive
events.notes: Ask who is staying near Bay St.; add extra hour for Forsyth stop and lunch with the girls.

events.title: Check checking acct before shift
events.notes: Expected work money in checking. Compare this morning's 1,748.22 with stub lines, including the 19.50 deduction marked Local 140.

events.title: Drop off containers + check pill tray
events.notes: Bring cooler bag from back seat. Replace tape on lids if marker smeared. Call before leaving station.

events.title: Bands, ice wrap, pack blue sleeve
events.notes: Before beach walk. Take water. Skip tablets unless breakfast is in first.

events.title: North beach walk with Renee
events.notes: Pack small camera, microfiber cloth, water bottle. Use old 50mm. Skip camera shop stop; insurance draft hits Monday. Try cafe on A1A after if time.

events.title: Renee + pier-to-jetty route
